name: Unidentified Western Reaches Exchange banking ship
wookieepedia_title: Unidentified Western Reaches Exchange banking ship
description: This banking ship was captained by the Kubaz Banker, Rikard Lovas. It would land at Niima Outpost on Jakku for a few days each cycle to allow the inhabitants to conduct business. It could carry a modestly sized cargo but many transactions were done electronically using credits.

data.name: Unidentified Western Reaches Exchange banking ship
